Starting Balances — Investments

The Starting Balances screen under the Investments tab allows you to set up the initial balances for your investments when you first start using Manager. This is useful when you have existing investments and want to bring their balances into your Manager accounting records accurately.

To create a new starting balance for an investment, follow these steps:

  1. Navigate to the Investments tab on the left sidebar.

  2. Click on the Starting Balances button at the top.

    InvestmentsNewStartingBalance

  3. On the Starting Balances screen, click the New Starting Balance button.

You will be taken to the Starting Balance entry screen for investments. Here, you can:

  • Select the investment account you wish to set a starting balance for.
  • Enter the date when the starting balance is effective.
  • Input the quantity and unit price of the investment.
  • Add any additional details or descriptions as needed.

For detailed instructions on completing the starting balance form for investments, see Starting Balance for Investment Form.

By setting up starting balances correctly, you ensure that your investment accounts reflect accurate values from the beginning, providing a solid foundation for your financial records in Manager.
